wa_banks_lake_ice_climbing_climb_above_s.approach: From the SR 155 roadside pullouts, walk the short distance to the flow you chose; nearly all of them can be seen from the road.

wa_banks_lake_ice_climbing_electric_aven.approach: From the SR 155 roadside pullouts, walk the short distance to the flow you chose; nearly all of them can be seen from the road.

approach_logistics.trailheadDirection: From Grand Coulee drive south on Highway 155, or from Coulee City drive north on it. Most of the frozen flows sit between mileposts 8 and 17, and you can pull off on the shoulder or in a pullout beside the one you want.
